settings.text: Solid hardwood — feels heavy, because it is
Eagle & stars detail burned in by hand, never printed
Arrives ready to hang — hardware included

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content: Free insured shipping anywhere in the U.S. In-stock pieces ship within 1 business day; most orders arrive in 3–5 business days. 60-day money-back guarantee — we even cover return shipping.

settings.title: Wood, Finish & Care
settings.content: Solid American hardwood with a hand-rubbed, furniture-grade finish. Dust with a dry cloth — that’s it. Keep out of direct rain and it will outlive all of us.

settings.heading: Every Carving Passes Through a Veteran's Hands.
settings.text: After 22 years in the U.S. Army, I couldn’t find a flag worth hanging — so I carved my own. Today, every piece that leaves this workshop is cut, burned, sealed, and signed by hand before it ships to your door.

settings.quote: Bought it for my dad — 26 years in the Marine Corps. He hung it over the fireplace the same day and just said, “Now that's a flag.”
settings.name: Sarah K.

settings.quote: I was worried it'd look like the printed stuff at the big-box stores. Then I picked it up. It's heavy, the eagle detail is unreal, and you can see where it was worked by hand.
settings.name: Mike D.

settings.quote: Third one I've ordered. One for the house, one for my brother's retirement from the Navy, one for my son's first home. This is what we'll pass down.
settings.name: Earl W.

settings.text: Lifetime craftsmanship warranty on every carving

settings.question: Is it really handmade in the USA?
settings.answer: Yes — every single carving is cut, burned, sealed, and signed in our American workshop. Nothing is imported, outsourced, or printed.

settings.question: How do I hang it?
settings.answer: It arrives ready to hang with keyhole mounts cut into the back and the hardware included. Most folks have it on the wall within five minutes of opening the box.

settings.question: How long until it arrives?
settings.answer: In-stock carvings ship within 1 business day, fully insured and free anywhere in the U.S. Most orders arrive in 3–5 business days.

settings.question: What if I don’t love it?
settings.answer: Send it back within 60 days for a full refund — we even cover the return shipping.
